slut.hostile: Oh, you're that easy slut wandering around, aren't you?
slut.mocking: Well, well... if it isn't the town bicycle.
slut.curious: I've heard... interesting things about your nighttime activities.
slut.neutral: Word travels fast about your... reputation.
slut.interested: So the rumors are true? You sound... fascinating.

criminal.hostile: I know what you've done. Watch yourself around here.
criminal.suspicious: You match the description of someone the guards are looking for.
criminal.curious: I've heard you have... useful skills.
criminal.neutral: Word is you're not exactly law-abiding.
criminal.impressed: I hear you've been causing trouble. Impressive.

corrupted.hostile: Stay away from me, you tainted creature!
corrupted.fearful: There's something wrong with you... I can feel it.
corrupted.curious: I've heard you've dabbled in dark arts...
corrupted.neutral: There are whispers about you and dark forces.
corrupted.interested: They say you've touched powers beyond mortal understanding.

heroic.admiring: You're the hero everyone's been talking about!
heroic.grateful: Thank the gods you're here! I've heard of your deeds!
heroic.curious: Is it true you defeated the beast of the woods?

mysterious.suspicious: Nobody knows where you came from. That's suspicious.
mysterious.curious: You're quite the enigma. Everyone's trying to figure you out.
mysterious.neutral: I've heard strange things about you.

success: Your reputation speaks for itself. They seem convinced.
They nod apologetically. 'I suppose rumors can be wrong.'
Your confident denial puts the matter to rest.
failure: They don't look convinced by your denial.
'If you say so...' they mutter, clearly unconvinced.
Your denial falls on deaf ears.

success: They pale and quickly change the subject.
'I-I didn't see anything!' they stammer, backing away.
Your threatening glare silences them immediately.

basic: You own your reputation with a confident smirk.
'Maybe I am,' you say with a knowing look.
You neither confirm nor deny, but your smile says it all.
seduce: You lean in close with a seductive smile...
'Why don't I show you personally?' you whisper.
Your eyes promise things words cannot express...

failure: Your nervous stammering only confirms their suspicions.
'I-I... that's not...' you trail off unconvincingly.
Your flustered response speaks louder than words.

success: Gold changes hands and memories conveniently fade.
They pocket the coins and suddenly remember nothing.
'What rumor?' they ask, pocketing your payment.

neutral: You pretend not to hear and continue on your way.
